name: Robust Watertight Manifold Surface Generation
definition: A pipeline that converts an input triangle mesh into a watertight 2-manifold surface with roughly uniformly distributed vertices, using an octree to represent the mesh and isosurface extraction, followed by vertex projection.
summary: Robust Watertight Manifold Surface Generation converts triangle meshes into watertight surfaces using octree-based signed distance fields, ensuring topological correctness through boundary-connected BFS and non-manifold resolution.
